Name: Vertical Positional Accuracy
Description: This TRE is used to describe the vertical accuracy when the horizontal accuracy varies across the region for which vertical accuracy is constant.

NUM_ACVT.Name: Number of Vertical Accuracy Regions
NUM_ACVT.Description: This field shall contain the number of vertical accuracy regions to follow.

UNIAAV<NUM_ACVT>.Name: Unit of Measure for the AAVn Field
UNIAAV<NUM_ACVT>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding AAVn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the absolute vertical accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

AAV<NUM_ACVT>.Name: Absolute Vertical Accuracy
AAV<NUM_ACVT>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding APVn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the point-to-point (relative) vertical accuracy is unknown or not applicable.

UNIAPV<NUM_ACVT>.Name: Unit of Measure for the AAVn Field
UNIAPV<NUM_ACVT>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding AAVn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the absolute vertical accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

APV<NUM_ACVT>.Name: Point-to-Point Vertical Accuracy
APV<NUM_ACVT>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAPVn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the point-to-point (relative) vertical accuracy for the nth vertical positional accuracy region.

NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>.Name: Number of Points in the Bounding Polygon
NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>.Description: This field defines the number of points (coordinate pairs) that are used to define the bounding polygon of the nth region of vertical accuracy. Coordinate values shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly in PRJPS). Whenever possible, the first and last points should be the same in order to close the polygon (e.g., a rectangular region would report five points), although this is not a strict requirement. If the accuracy information applies to the entire Image Segment (the value of NUM_ACVT = 1 and the ACCPO extension is not present), then this field does not apply and will contain 000.

LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>>.Name: Longitude / Easting
LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Longitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.

LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>>.Name: Latitude / Northing
LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACVT>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Latitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.
